source_issue.title: "manage-translations" view can be viewed by anonymous

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue addresses a bug where the "manage-translations" view is accessible by anonymous users, which should not happen. Instead, they should receive a 404 error or redirected to a login page.

## What needs to be done
The goal is to implement a permission check for the "manage-translations" route so that only logged-in users can access it. This will involve editing the `Multilingual/ManageTranslations.jsx` component to ensure proper authorization.

## Helpful background
The current behavior allows anyone to view the "manage-translations" page, which poses a security risk. The function of routes in Volto can be somewhat unique; nonContentRoutes don't pull content from the backend but are meant to redirect or show specific content based on user credentials.

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with the `Multilingual/ManageTranslations.jsx` component and its role in the routing system.
2. Check existing route handling mechanisms in the codebase, especially focusing on how permission checks are structured.
3. Plan the changes needed to include a user authentication check to restrict access.
4. Consider looking into relevant documentation for route management to ensure you understand the implications of your changes.
5. After implementing, remember to test the changes thoroughly and document your approach in the project for clarity.
```
